sheets.prompt: Use the generated way-lamp and the existing game lamp and stone art as references. Create one centered icon of the same hooded iron lamp on a compact cairn stone footing, steadily lit with warm amber flame. Transparent square canvas, crisp pixel clusters, earthy Wilds palette, #3a2a28 outline, no text, border, scenery, cast shadow, smoothing or antialiasing. Keep the complete lamp visible.

Create three transparent pixel-art inventory icons in separate equal cells: grey ash with one amber ember; an ash-grey drawstring pouch with ash at the neck; and a leaning metal turncap set in amber. Chunky clusters readable at 16x16, warm dark outline, upper-left light, no background, text, blur, antialiasing or watermark.
sheets.method: Built-in image_gen source sheet retained. build_manifest.py measures each cell and records source rectangles; the items atlas builder scales each crop to its 16x16 inventory canvas.
